story:
A boy meets his childhood crush and a girl falls in love

It felt like something written in the stars. We were just two little schoolmates, side by side from nursery through Grade 1, until life quietly pulled us apart when she transferred to another school. Years passed—eight long, growing years—before fate brought us back together at a school reunion. What began as distant, awkward conversations slowly turned into a renewed friendship, and before we knew it, the innocent crush from childhood blossomed into our first true love.

Now, hand in hand, we stand on the edge of a brand-new chapter, ready to continue the love story that once began in a classroom long ago.
